customer_message.subject: Defect in rented flat Feldstrasse 8, Thun – heating failure and request for support
customer_message.body:
Dear Livit-Partner Verwaltungen AG claims team,

I am writing regarding my 3-room flat at Feldstrasse 8 in Thun, which I rent from you. The heating in the flat keeps failing. Several radiators stay cold, and the temperature in the flat drops to about 16 degrees. I have reported this to the property management several times, but the defect has not been fixed so far.

Since the cold started, a member of my household has suffered from repeated colds and bronchitis. We are convinced that the low temperatures in the flat are the cause, although I cannot prove this medically.

As far as I understand, the cause of the heating failure is still unclear. I believe that a technical expert inspection by a building or heating specialist is needed to establish what is wrong and who is responsible for repairing it.

I am not sure yet whether I will pay the rent into the official rent deposit account (Hinterlegung) if the defect is not remedied. I would like to first understand my options and the steps involved before I decide.

Could you please confirm that you will arrange an inspection, and let me know what support your company can provide to me in this matter? I am happy to discuss this by phone at any time.

Kind regards

Lee Harper
